problem: Districts spend on programs without knowing which affect student outcomes; Glimpse tracked activities and compared them to achievement to cut ineffective spending.

technical_complexity.rationale: Data integration and analytics dashboards over district data; hard part is messy district systems.

defensibility.rationale: District data integrations create some switching cost but the analytics were copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Acquirer and date not found in a source; PitchBook snippet says February 2023, unverified.

market_need_then: District budgets and ROI pressure existed but willingness to pay for spending analytics was unproven.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand found; the GLIMPSE mark is registered by Glimpse K12, Inc. but the word is generic and shared by many companies.

outcome_analysis: Glimpse K12 was a six person Huntsville, Alabama team selling spending effectiveness analytics to districts, backed by YC and edtech funds. YC lists it as acquired, but no acquirer, date or terms were found beyond an unverified PitchBook date, so the outcome quality and causes cannot be assessed from public sources.
notes: glimpsek12.com returned 503. Funding conflicts and is aggregator only: CB Insights $560K over four rounds, Bouncewatch $2M seed on 2018-06-11 plus $120K pre-seed, PitchBook $2M; the round amount is left null. Round stage not stated by source so labelled other. CB Insights lists Adam Pearson as founder; YC lists Nicole Pezent only. Competitor list from CB Insights is undated so omitted. PitchBook acquisition date 2023-02-10 unverified. Other companies named Glimpse (a16z-backed 2026) were excluded.
